summary: Veea Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Note Conversion Agreement with NLabs Inc., an affiliate of the CEO, exchanging $4.13M in principal and accrued interest on demand notes for 41,329 Series A-1 preferred shares (stated value $100 per share, convertible into 13.3M common shares) and warrants to purchase 13.3M common shares at $0.31, exercisable from January 2027 to June 2031. The conversion resolves debt overhang and bolsters equity, with registration rights for the underlying shares. The board presumably approved; advisors not named. Watch for dilution impact and potential shareholder reaction.
